header: THE SAVED FARES TO EVERY STOP AFTER DURGAPUR (table public.train_fare_leg, src/lib/nl2sql/sql/22_train_fare_leg.sql). I keep one row per train and stop, each with the time it was received. I follow the same pattern as fareStore.ts: database trouble is logged once and the store then answers "nothing saved" (list) or does nothing (put); I never show a row that is not the shape written.

behaviours: nothing is saved at first, and the table is made on first use
the stops of a train come back in ROUTE order (not the order saved), with the time received, and not those of another train
a train's stop has one row: saving it again replaces the fares and the time
the table is checked once, not at every request
the table statements close it to the public roles
the stations with saved fares come back with their names and how many trains go there (for the search)
the fares to one station: every train that goes there, with its name, its fare, the time received
the coverage says how many trains have fares and how many have fares to their stops
if the table cannot be made or read, list says nothing is saved and put does nothing, without an error
a row is read (classes as text or data, numbers as text)
a row with a broken time, no classes, a broken class, a bad code or day, or a fractional place is not shown
the Asansol leg store writes, reads, lists stops and joins only the _asn tables, and makes its table by itself
